verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents mandate-based purchase intents (declineThreshold, effectiveUntilTime, mandateId) that let an agent autonomously execute payments within pre-consented bounds without per-transaction human approval, which is the core 'runs autonomously in background' mechanism for this payments-focused product. However the product itself carries a documented maturity caveat ('in the process of development and deployment'), and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of an automation actually running unattended over time; some flows also require passkey step-up per instruction, which narrows true hands-off autonomy. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of end-to-end unattended operation, clarity on how often re-authentication interrupts autonomy, and evidence beyond payments-specific mandates.
